task.request: Determine whether an authenticated repository-read collaborator, who is neither a repository administrator nor a site administrator, may query a different existing collaborator's repository permission using GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{collaborator}/permission.

policySources.text: A caller may query collaborator permission when querying self, as a repository administrator, or as a site administrator; otherwise deny.

acceptance.reason: The user supplied this bounded normative policy.

principals.description: Neither a repository administrator nor a site administrator; querying a different existing collaborator.

resources.description: Permission of a different existing collaborator in the selected repository.

conditions.name: not administrator
conditions.basis: The caller is neither repository admin nor site admin.

conditions.name: different existing collaborator
conditions.basis: The requested username belongs to a different existing collaborator.
